title: 12.3 Million People Attended a Concert That Had No Venue

scenes.text: 12.3 million people attended a concert with no venue.
It happened inside Fortnite in April 2020. The show was Travis Scott's Astronomical.
At its peak, 12.3 million players were online at the same time.
That was about two million more than the game's previous record, set a year earlier.
No ticket, no stage. Players watched a giant Travis Scott stomp across the map.
The biggest crowd Fortnite had ever seen, and nobody left their room.

description:
12.3 million people attended a concert with no venue.
Travis Scott's Astronomical show in Fortnite in April 2020 drew about 12.3 million players at once, the most concurrent players the game had seen, about two million more than the previous record.
Would you go to a concert inside a game? Comment below.
